description: Small Python command-line word counter with unittest tests and a project README

profile.PROJECT_NAME_AND_PURPOSE: wc-cli: counts lines, words and characters in text files for the maintainer's scripts
profile.PRIMARY_JOURNEYS: Count a file from the command line; count standard input in a pipeline
profile.SCOPE: Included: counting and output formats. Excluded: network access, GUIs, binary files
profile.TECHNOLOGY_STACK: Python 3.10+ standard library only; no third-party dependencies; no storage
profile.REPOSITORY_LAYOUT: `wc_cli/` package, `tests/` unittest suite, no generated files
profile.SUPPORTED_ENVIRONMENTS: Linux and macOS with Python 3.10 or later
profile.DATA_AND_TRUST_BOUNDARIES: Reads local files the user names; no personal or confidential data; no network
profile.EXCLUDED_GUIDES_OR_NONE: UI guides (no UI), DATA_PORTABILITY (no import/export), RUNBOOKS and PRODUCTION_READINESS (Prototype tier)
